changes.title: Broom parts art
items: The Workshop's nine broom parts each have their own picture: a riveted missile nose, a carved hobby-horse head, twin jet nozzles with their pilot flames, a wild twig bundle and more
Her broom on the bay is built from the parts she's fitted
The parts hang on pegs on the biome board, which is darker so they stand out

changes.title: Pack specials
items: Rams, ibex and rhinos now fight in packs, one charging to throw you; spiders, crocodiles and griffins drag you in; raccoons wave to catch your 💌s

changes.title: Finds dev
items: For testing: a "finds (dev)" panel in the debug overlay (~) gives or takes away any find (clothes, broom parts), as if she'd found it; ?own=all or ?own=none in the link does the same
For testing: spawn any find a few metres in front of her (or move tonight's find there) from the same panel or the pause page's 🧪 Finds button
